label: Received esse yields an actual giver through essence distinction and q.3 a.4 (inference)
rule: Shared-witness composition: R1/R3 and receptive irreflexivity give B6, q.3 a.4 gives B2, cause presence upgrades its bearer
meaning: For the same contingent x and world w, reuse the verified R1/R3/De ente/irreflexivity consequence B6, the existing actual-esse and ST I q.3 a.4 interpretation to obtain a distinct cause c of x's esse, and the existing selected-world presence interface to establish that c exists at w. This alternate to the received-esse-causal-coverage route shares R1 and the presence bridge. It does not deduce efficient giving directly from receipt or identify a receiver with an external source.
